scene_context.physical_setting: Residential living room; crowded with furniture and people
scene_context.social_context: group activity; birthday celebration involving family and friends
scene_context.emotional_atmosphere: Sentimental, celebratory, shifting to overwhelming joy

characters.physical_description: Adult male, grey hair, wearing black hoodie with orange logo, seated on leather couch

initial_state.body_language_summary: Seated, relaxed posture, gaze fixed on off-screen TV, slight smiling
initial_state.apparent_goal: To receive social validation and watch the video message

final_state.body_language_summary: Standing, tight embrace, sobbing, face buried in other man's shoulder
final_state.apparent_goal: To maintain physical closeness with the surprise guest

behavioral_evidence: Transition from relaxed sitting to wiping eyes
Transition to sobbing and tight hugging

characters.physical_description: Adult male, short hair, wearing blue plaid shirt

initial_state.body_language_summary: Approaching stealthily from behind, leaning over couch
behavioral_evidence: Leaning over the back of the couch

final_state.body_language_summary: Standing, embracing seated_man_black_hoodie, patting his back
final_state.apparent_goal: To comfort and connect with the celebrant

behavioral_evidence: Maintains embrace despite the other man's overwhelming emotion

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Subject is passively receiving social signals (song, video message). He remains seated and attentive, wiping tears, indicating emotional resonance with the social content.

supporting_evidence.description: Sitting still, oriented toward the screen

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Unexpected tactile stimulus (hands on shoulders) and auditory stimulus (voice behind him) violates his belief state (that the friend is on the screen). Immediate reaction is a startle response and rapid orienting to identify the source.

supporting_evidence.description: Rapid head turn and twisting of torso to see behind

alternative_interpretations.reasoning: The startle response is a defensive reflex, suggesting a momentary fear of threat before recognition.
alternative_interpretations.why_not_primary: The context is a safe environment and recognition happens almost instantly, making it an epistemic shock rather than a genuine safety threat.

desire_motivation_analysis.reasoning_chain: Upon recognizing the friend, the subject immediately transitions from shock to seeking close physical contact. He stands up to facilitate a full embrace, prioritizing this connection over the video or the rest of the room.

supporting_evidence.description: Standing up from the couch to face the guest
Closing distance to zero, initiating tight hug

trigger_event.description: surprise_guest_plaid_shirt touches his shoulders and speaks from behind

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: The exact moment his body jolts and he breaks gaze with the TV to look behind him.
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: A classic 'Expectation Violation' where the BDI model's belief state (friend is remote) clashes with sensory input (friend is tactile), triggering an immediate re-orienting reflex.

trigger_event.description: Visual recognition of the friend's face

behavioral_markers.description: Expression shifts from shock to emotional release (crying/smiling)
Arms reaching out to wrap around the guest

desire_transitions.visual_marker_of_change: When the tension of the startle releases and he actively pulls the other man into a hug.
desire_transitions.psychological_interpretation: The resolution of the epistemic uncertainty leads immediately to the satisfaction of a high-priority Belonging need.

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Wiping tears from eyes, slight nodding
behavioral_sequence.relevance_to_desire: Indicates the high value placed on the relationship being depicted, setting the stage for the intensity of the reunion.

behavioral_sequence.behavior_description: Whole-body startle response, jumping in seat
behavioral_sequence.relevance_to_desire: Marks the interruption of the previous state and the urgent need to identify the stimulus.
Demonstrates the fulfillment of the Social_Affiliation desire.

key_segments_for_qa.segment_description: The moment the guest reveals himself and the celebrant reacts.
key_segments_for_qa.psychological_significance: Perfect example of belief violation and rapid emotional state transition (Shock -> Joy).

inter_character_dynamics.mutual_influence: The guest's presence triggers a massive emotional release in the celebrant; the celebrant's reaction validates the guest's effort.

annotation_metadata.annotation_notes: The audio context (video message saying 'wish I could be there') is crucial for understanding the intensity of the belief violation when the guest actually appears.
